notes.title: Eden Survivors: Now in Early Access! Play, Explore, and Share Your Feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/c12f4e5dc2a575d4f32c6510f5cb1f338ac07f11.jpg[/img]
[h3]Eden Survivors is now available in Early Access!
[/h3]
The wait is over! 🌟 We’re thrilled to announce that Eden Survivors is now available on Early Access on Steam. This is just the beginning of an adventure we’ll build together, and we want YOU to be a part of it!

🎮 What’s included in this Early Access version?

This first version is packed with content ready for you to explore:

1 complete biome, full of secrets to uncover and challenges to conquer.
All abilities and a progression tree, giving you the freedom to experiment and adapt your playstyle.
4 unique mechs, each with its own gameplay style for you to master.
All final bosses of the first biome, bringing epic challenges we can’t wait for you to tackle!
20 to 100 hours of gameplay, depending on how deeply you dive into this epic experience.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073350/Eden_Survivors/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073350/Eden_Survivors/
[/url]

🗨️ Your feedback is key
This is just the beginning. We want to hear your thoughts and learn how we can improve. Share your feedback on our forums, social media, or Discord. Your input will be essential to shaping Eden Survivors into its best version!

📣 Join the conversation: Forums, Discord, Social Media,

🚀 Play, explore, and be part of Eden Survivors’ evolution

notes.title: New Gameplay Feature + New Reward
notes.content:
As our Kickstarter progresses, we listen to the community, keep their feedback in mind and improve the game experience and the campaign! Thanks to your constant support, we've decided to include a brand-new gameplay mechanic and a new reward!

[h2][b]Competitive Multiplayer Mode[/b][/h2]

Eden Genesis will feature a cross-platform worldwide leaderboard upon its final release. This will allow players to compete against any user, whether they're friends or not, proving themselves to be the best and reaching the top of the ranking.

Are you willing to show your skills in front of the entire community? We want you to leave us speechless! You will find more details about this addition on the campaign page:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/0db4a24794e45c5c3d66af629bca5a4a32358656.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/7083f82aa3cbfba204ffd8880a8d1d746e922fe0.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]New reward[/b][/h2]

We are still in the middle of Kickstarter, so we have decided to include a new reward that also encourages the addition of the competitive mode.

"Early Competitive" is the name of this new tier, which includes 2 Eden Genesis keys for you and a friend. This way you can both enjoy our cyberpunk adventure and compete with each other to get the best score. Hurry up, there are very limited units!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrNU1EVTVNVEE9


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/b16a8c9607514a24a30c0b8b621b0705149bf776.png[/img]

Once again, thanks a lot for supporting indie games :)

notes.title: Eden Genesis has reached its Kickstarter goal in record time
notes.content:
Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] reached its fund goal in just over 48 hours after the release!

Great news for the whole dev team, and we’d like to thank you all for making it possible in record time. It’s been months of hard work and getting funded in a matter of hours means a lot to us. We were confident about it, and as a token of gratitude, let’s take a look at some of the most important stretch goals we prepared for our lovely community.

The campaign for this cyberpunk platformer hides tons of surprises, including both physical rewards and extra in-game content. You’re about to learn about the first two, one that includes more gameplay options, and the other focused on getting a more immersive experience … Excited enough?

[h2][b]New tier reward[/b][/h2]

It is an expansion of the Level A Ghost (+Physical) tier but adding a digital copy of Eden Genesis for Steam. The new tier is called “Level A Ghost Plus (+Physical)”, and it has been created thanks to the feedback from the community on social media.

Thanks for your constant suggestions and contributions to the project! If you want to access this new reward at an incredible price, visit [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrNE9ESTROek09]this link[/url].

[h2][b]First stretch goal, a replay and practice mode[/b][/h2]

Each trial in Eden Genesis is different from the last, presenting a unique level design and enemy presence. Your ultimate goal is achieving the best score by eliminating all hostile entities, cleaning the SND and keeping your synchro levels at maximum.

Thanks to this stretch goal you can practice adding your own checkpoints to familiarize yourself with the level. The training mode will allow you to perfect your reflexes and marks when you come to a test that seems too complex or in which you do not obtain the expected results.

By being able to add and remove checkpoints at will, you will not need to repeat the entire level. Focus on that section that you are struggling with, and practice as much as you want until you are completely familiar with the enemy layout and platform design.

[h2][b]Second stretch goal, dubbing[/b][/h2]

Eden Genesis is more than a fast-paced platformer, it also features a deep story and in order to make it more immersive, we aim to get full English dubbing for in-game dialogues.

Wish to know more? As soon as the first stretch goal is done, we’ll share more details about it…

Once again, thank you so much for your support. Let’s make the replay and practice mode a reality 😊

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/ea199714fa530df1973958eeeda54fd725d90343.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.0.001
notes.content:
[b]Base game[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where metal platforms would get stuck in the battle against the Phoenix
[*]Removed a prompt that appeared behind some map vendors
[*]You can now attack with the Katana vertically up and down when playing with the keyboard
[*]Katana cooldown time has been adjusted: 0.1s -> 0.3s
[/list]
[b]Virtuoso DLC[/b]
[list]
[*]The Erudite achievement can be unlocked when you complete the base game quests (including "Pit of the Damned") + the "Virtuoso" one
[*]The no-hit achievement can now be unlocked when facing the sword in Boss Rush mode
[*]Fixed an issue where fogs of war would disappear from games started when playing the DLC
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed skill points to be duplicated in Boss Rush mode
[*]Fixed an issue where the King of Darkness would get stuck when healing in Mythic
[*]Fixed a bug in the Sword fight in mythic where the King of Darkness would sometimes disappear when entering portals
[/list]
[b]Easy Anti Cheat has been removed[/b]

Aeternum Game Studios has decided to remove the EAC feature from Aeterna Noctis to ensure full accessibility to players and also in response to the demands of the community.

We understand that the addition of this functionality has not been well-received by certain sectors, and has also posed a problem for those players who for accessibility reasons have not been able to enjoy the title.

Instead, we have designed our own anti-cheat system that only applies to the leaderboards of the timed trials. This way, the stats obtained will remain legitimate without affecting the rest of the content of Aeterna Noctis, that is, gameplay elements and features that are single-player.

We have always listened to the community. This has been one of our hallmarks as a dev team. It is thanks to your suggestions that the Aeterna Universe has never stopped including improvements based on player feedback. The message was clear, EAC was an addition that was not liked and now it is history.

We would be very grateful if, just as you have expressed your disagreement with the inclusion of EAC, now that it has been removed from the title, you would also share it on the Steam forum and the rest of the networks, so that the news reaches all players. We trust that this decision will allow Aeterna Noctis to be valued solely for its playable values.

Long live the King of Darkness!

notes.title: Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso" is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Content included in Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso"[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589720/Aeterna_Noctis_Virtuoso/

[h2]New game mode[/h2]
Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso features the long-awaited boss rush mode. Now players can repeat the boss fights from the base game including new enemy behaviour and attack patterns.

During these battles, your powers will be restricted to ensure a fair duel, this way, you will also be able to perform feats that you may not have achieved in your first encounter: defeating bosses in a particular way or without getting hit.

If you prefer an even greater challenge you can face them one after the other.

The Collector is the NPC that introduces the boss rush mode to players. Visit his true collection and overcome the different challenges and boss groups until you defeat all of them in every modality.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/c4b22956984de8a9574bc0ac28c84f716ee891ee.png[/img]
[h2]New boss fight[/h2]
The Clockwork Twins are the new bosses included in the DLC. They can be found (and beaten) in the boss rush mode, offering an encounter only recommended for the most skilled players.

This brand-new final boss features unique mechanics that will put your reflexes to the test. You must face these monstrosities in an exclusive arena.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/f111456a0a866060cd93e91ec9c2370f5d209b28.png[/img]
[h2]New achievements[/h2]
A new batch of achievements has been included thanks to Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso. Believe us when we say that some of them are only accessible to true champions of the Darkness.

notes.title: Aeterna Noctis prepares for the imminent "Virtuoso" DLC
notes.content:
Thanks to this update, Aeterna Noctis is now ready to allow access to the "Virtuoso" content, which will be available next Thursday, November 9.

You can now enjoy some free additions on the occasion of the imminent launch of the Boss Rush DLC. Let's see what this update includes:

[h2]More accessibility[/h2]
We've included a "How to Play" section to provide a shortcut to movement and combat controls by simply pausing the game and accessing this index.

No matter how long you haven't played or whether you have questions about the King of Darkness's movement options, you can now consult all the control information thanks to the "How to Play" section, including images and descriptions.

[h2]Remixed OST[/h2]
All of the songs that accompany final boss fights in the base game have been updated with the remastered versions included in "Virtuoso." If you have started a new game, all boss fights now feature improved background music.

These new versions will also be available in the DLC battle room.

[h2]Changes to the base game[/h2]
The way the Lance of Cycles works has been changed by adding a 2 seconds cooldown. This way, its handling becomes more balanced.

They have also made some performance improvements, and fixed minor bugs reported by the community.

[h2]Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso"[/h2]
The Boss Rush DLC for our Metroidvania will arrive next week, available on November 9 on Steam and consoles. Add it to your wish list!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589720/Aeterna_Noctis_Virtuoso/

notes.title: Free DLC "Pit of the Damned" is now available
notes.content:
[h1]"Pit of the Damned": New Content and Improvements[/h1]

[h2][b]New areas[/b][/h2]

2 new areas have been added:
[list]
[*] Pit of the Damned: An old underground vault that has been unexplored for cycles. Who knows the mysteries and dangers hidden in its collapsed galleries and burial chambers... 

[*] Belly of the Beast: An inhospitable area, with organic walls and throbbing floors... An ancient evil dwells inside, and has just awakened from its lethargy.

[*] Artificial Dimensions: A brand new area accessible through portals scattered throughout the Aeterna Noctis map. It is an artificial environment, a vestige of an ancient civilization that disappeared years ago...
[/list]Thanks to these additions, Aeterna Noctis features 19 unique and interconnected areas!

[h2][b]New challenges available[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Timed trials: A series of trials that will put your skills to the test, making a total of 12 spread across the game map. Within these challenges, your skills will be restricted, and you will have the chance to compete to beat your own mark... and against other players!

[*] Multiplayer leaderboard: Stand out in world statistics thanks to the multiplayer and cross-platform scoreboard incorporated into this new game modality
[/list]
[h2][b]New missions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] No Whip and Hat: Help Lord Drake VI explore some ancient catacombs located under the Wasteland of the Fallen

[*] The Legacy of a Cursed Lineage: The Pit of the Damned hides more than just resentment and death. Find your way into the depths of the excavation and face your destiny

[*] Breach in the Matrix: Find all entrances to the Artificial Dimensions
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications in base game missions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The Art of the Collector: Changed the percentages needed to advance in each mission state

[*] The Soul Mirror: No longer drops the gem "Sleight of Hand" as a final reward
[/list]
[h2][b]New enemies[/b][/h2]

The Pit of the Damned is inhabited by both old acquaintances and new creatures:
[list]
[*] Blade Vassal
[*] Dynastic Sentinel
[*] Protector of the Invictus
[*] Tomb Rodent
[*] Mole Wasp Hive
[*] Mole Wasps
[*] King Worm
[*] Symbiotic Globule
[*] Intestinal Basophil
[/list]Defeat these enemies and add them to your collection. Obtain them all 

[h2][b]New final bosses[/b][/h2]

A terrible evil dwells in the depths of the Pit of the Damned...

Face your destiny and discover the horror that inhabits the catacombs by facing the 2 new final bosses included, adding a total of 19 in the entire game

[h2][b]Gameplay adjustments[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new zone in the Cosmos area accessible only through the teleport gate
[*] Game progress has increased beyond 100%, reaching 109% (max percentage)
[*] Certain enemies have been recalibrated to make them easier to obtain in the collection
[*] Shooting assist sight is now enabled by default and can be disabled from the options menu
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Leech" and "The Vampire's Soul" gems would sometimes not work correctly
[*] Adjusted the "Guardian Angel" skill to restore 30% of your health in Noctis Mode and 70% in Aeterna Mode
[*] Certain platforming sections have been recalibrated to better match the difficulty
[*] Dragons now do not deal damage when hit from above
[*] Fixed a bug where the soul retrieval tutorial would sometimes not appear correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Edge of the Master" weapon would sometimes not damage certain enemies
[*] Fixed several bugs that prevented unlocking certain achievements
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses did not feature their life bar represented in the damage pop up
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes enemies would not resurrect correctly
[*] The "Guardian Angel" skill now recharges when visiting a throne
[*] Fixed a bug where Enraged Spirits' death particles would sometimes remain on death
[*] Fixed a bug where player stats were sometimes not reflected correctly in the skills menu
[/list]
[h2][b]New gems[/b][/h2]

3 gemas azules:
[list]
[*] Crystallized Soul: You do not lose your soul after being defeated
[*] Vertigo: Adds an extra jump charge
[*] Mortal Temptation: Increases your damage by 100%, but you are defeated in one hit
[/list]
2 purple gems:
[list]
[*] Last Resort: The Dark Shield activates automatically when you are hit, but its recharge time is doubled
[*] Gluttony: Increases your damage by 50% when your blood pools are at maximum
[/list]
1 red gem:
[list]
[*] Phantom Dash: You are invulnerable while using the Rush, this effect has a 4 second cooldown
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications on base game gems[/b][/h2]

The behavior of some gems has been modified:
[list]
[*] Celestial Lens: Automatically aim at the nearest enemy
[*] Sorcerer's pact: You heal automatically if you have enough blood available
[*] Soul of Amaterasu: The Edge of the Master will execute a larger and more powerful cut
[*] Soul of Susanoo: Doubles the damage dealt by the feint
[*] Infinite Flare: Spear of Cycles now does not consume blood when used
[*] Sagittarius Eye: Adds an additional projectile to each shot
[/list]
The obtaining method of certain gems has also been modified:
[list]
[*] Bloodthirsty Ruby: Now obtained by playing 8 piano scores
[*] Prestidigitation: Can now be purchased from Asnur's shop after defeating the T-900
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications on base game weapons[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] Spear of Cycles: 
[list]
- Removed the charge time when executing the spear attack
- The Dark King is now invulnerable while executing this attack
- Falling speed has been increased
[/list]

[*] Edge of the Master:
[list]
- The recovery time after performing an attack has been reduced
- Removed the stall time after performing a feint
[/list] [/list]
[h2][b]New achievements[/b][/h2]

Added 18 new achievements
[list]
[*] Master of Ceremonies: Interpret all the musical scores on the piano
[*] Take your time: Complete all simulations on bronze level
[*] Professional Speedrunner: Complete all simulations on platinum level
[*] Against the clock (x13): Complete each simulation on platinum level. There is a different achievement for each numbered simulation
[*] 2 hidden achievements related to the story of the Pit of the Damned
[/list]
5 complimentary achievements have been added to the many others that were already present in the base game:
[list]
[*] Tourist info point +: Find and read every lore point in Pit of the Damned
[*] Well gifted +: Get as many skill points as possible in the Pit of the Damned
[*] Infinity Gems +: Obtain all power gems in the Pit of the Damned
[*] Gotta obtain them all +: Complete the bestiary collection including all creatures from Pit of the Damned
[*] Erudite +: Complete all quests in the Pit of the Damned
[/list]
[h2][b]Miscellany[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance has been optimized in all game areas
[*] Adjusted lighting in all areas
[*] Errors have been corrected in the texts and descriptions
[*] Fixed a bug where the elevator in Cradle of Light would sometimes not work correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the number of gears was not displayed in certain languages during the quest "Crystal Elevator"
[*] Changed death animation after falling into traps
[*] Changed the price of the hilt in the Asnur shop
[*] Fixed a bug where the aim assist crosshair was not displayed correctly in certain areas
[*] 13 new songs have been included that provide background music to the new areas and environments
[*] 4 new collectable sheet music have been added. Find them all and interpret them on the piano
[/list]

notes.title: New update with accessibility options and improvements to combat and movement!
notes.content:
[h1]Aeterna Noctis Patch Notes v1.1.000[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved collision calculation for sword and scythe attacks
[*] Added a new combat assist system to improve the attack rate of the sword and scythe
[*] Increased the jump assist window time when falling from a platform by 50% to improve the King of Darkness reaction time
[*] Improved the ground jump assist window to prevent it from consuming the double jump if the King is too close to a platform
[*] A new assistance system has been included to improve the calculation of side collisions when hitting platforms
[*] Balanced the life of some Bosses in "Aeterna" Mode
[*] Balanced the health of the four doomsday dragons from 1200 to 800 health
[*] Slugs will now not explode instantly if the damage they take exceeds 100% of their health
[/list]
[h2]Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cost of the following weapons has been adjusted:
[list]Ax: 30 -> 20 blood points
Spear: 30 -> 20 blood points
Katana Slash: 35 -> 20 blood points
Katana Feint: 35 -> 25 blood points[/list]

[*] "Light Alloy" gem effect increased from 5% to 10% critical chance
[*] Increased the effect of the "Minor Enhancer" gem from 20% to 35% critical damage

[*] Increased the effect of the "Thirsty Ruby" gem from 25% to 50%
[/list]
[h2]Upgrade Tree:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Guardian Angel" skill node has been redesigned:
[list]Grants 100% revive on death, and heals the King of Darkness for 100% health. Recharges each time you are defeated. Does not work against spikes or traps.
Added a "Guardian Angel" indicator on the HUD[/list][*] The effect of the initial 6 nodes has been doubled to adjust the player's progress more correctly to the difficulty curve
[*] The effect of the "Combat Charge" node has been improved from 1 to 2 seconds and from 20% to 30% damage
[*] "On the Verge of Death" node effect increased from 20% to 50% damage
[*] "Iron Health" node effect increased from 20% to 30% damage
[*] Improved the effect of the "Quick Arrow" node by removing the 1 second effect duration time, now the next shot after a fast recovery will have no ammo cost
[*] Improved the effect of the "Bloody Death" node by increasing the spilt blood from 1 to 2 units
[*] The effect of the "Doctor" node has been improved, now the effects of the King of Darkness cures are twice as powerful
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed various platform bugs where sometimes achievements/trophies were not being delivered correctly despite having met the requirements. The achievements obtained by the players will be delivered automatically when opening the menu within a game (It is possible that some achievements are not delivered correctly if the platform did not register them as completed internally at the time of obtaining it)
[/list]

[*] Fixed various localization bugs
[*] Fixed a bug where turning off vibration in the options menu would cause some actions to still vibrate
[*] Fixed a bug where loading game in "Temple of Kings 3" would cause the camera to go out of bounds
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the graphics quality to be changed on some consoles

[*] Fixed a bug where "Dark Portal" could be performed in the final boss battle
[*] Fixed a bug where progress after the final boss battle would sometimes not be saved correctly

notes.title: New patch featuring a new game mode!
notes.content:
New patch featuring a new game mode!

- Aeterna Mode: new game mode with redesigned platforms and puzzles for a more accessible experience focused on action and exploration

- Noctis Mode: the studio original version

The patch is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store and PlayStation 5!  It will be ready for Xbox Series in two days, the platform must approve it first.


[b]Main notes for the patch v1.0.005:[/b]

- The new game mode "Aeterna" (reduced difficulty and redesign of platforms-puzzles) has been implemented. At the moment, there will be no achievements in this mode but we are working on it.

- The new game mode "Noctis" (Current Difficulty) has been implemented

- It is possible to switch between the two difficulty modes at any time from the "pause menu"

- A "Skull" indicator has been implemented in the HUD when playing in "Noctis" mode.

- Fixed a bug where some players would lose the fog of war from the map when restarting the game

- Fixed a bug whereby the game was not saved correctly, causing rollbacks to previous points in the game (PS5)

- The performance of volumetric lights has been improved

- Loading between scenes has been improved to optimize the memory used in the transition

- Small visual bugs have been fixed

- Enemies have been balanced in both difficulty modes to better match game progression

- Some King's weapons have been balanced in both difficulty modes to better match game progression

- The number of indicators on the map for collectibles and quests has been increased

- The number of thrones has been increased in both difficulty modes to facilitate exploration

- The gold obtained in the chests has been increased

- Errors in obtaining some achievements have been corrected (Achievements already completed will be given to players when accessing the progress menu)

- Checkpoints have been increased in some sections

- A bug that allowed unlimited money to be obtained through the "collection" has been corrected

- Fixed a bug that modified button actions when using PS4 controller

- The action "Interact" has been included in the remapping of controls, this will not modify the interaction notice prompt.

notes.title: We announce two game modes for Aeterna Noctis!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gdr8tGb.jpg[/img]

Following the feedback we've received, Aeterna Noctis should have two game modes:

[*][b]Noctis Mode[/b] which is the actual game experience

[*][b]Aeterna Mode[/b] featuring redesigned platforms and puzzles for a more accessible experience focused on action and exploration
[/list]
This new implements will come soon with the next update!
